page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 64.0 GB of system memory, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded workloads. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and a poor single-threaded gzip compression result in the bottom 10%. However, the instance demonstrates average multi-core performance across several tests, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU benchmarks. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached operations remains in the average tier, supporting steady data transfer rates.

Given its hardware profile and performance characteristics, the ecs.sn2.3xlarge is suited for workloads that leverage multi-threaded processing rather than raw single-core speed. Appropriate use cases include static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate Redis deployments, all of which perform in the average tier. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a standard resource density for general-purpose computing, though the lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment for persistent data.
